tables.reason: One row per unique product code (00470001–00470012) with product name, currency, unit, price list, tax-exclusive price and tax rate — a product master with an embedded standard price list. 12 rows, no duplicates on 商品コード.

columns.name: 商品コード
columns.reason: Header means 'product code'; 12 distinct values for 12 rows, sequential 00470001–00470012. Zero-padded 8-digit values must be read as text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: 通貨

columns.name: 単位
columns.reason: Header means 'unit'; constant value PCS, which is in the sell_unit enum_hint. No pack-size column present, so /unit/pack_size stays unmapped.

columns.name: 価格リスト
columns.reason: Header means 'price list'; constant value 'standard', matching the contract default and explicitly stated per row.

columns.name: 税抜価格
columns.reason: Header means 'price excluding tax'; 12 distinct numeric amounts (1234–2334), one per product, feeding the single standard price entry. Value is the tax-exclusive amount, consistent with the 税込 = 'いいえ' flag and the 5% rate column.

columns.name: 税込
columns.reason: Header means 'tax included (?)'; constant value 'いいえ' = 'no', i.e. the listed price is not VAT-inclusive, agreeing with the 税抜価格 header. Encoded as boolean false rather than a literal string.

columns.name: 税率
columns.reason: Header means 'tax rate'; constant explicit source value '5%' → 0.05 fraction. This is an explicit fixture tax rate from the file, not a country-convention inference.

Added quality rules for SKU uniqueness/not-null and positive price amounts.
No /inventory, /promotions, /category, /brand, /description or price effective-date mappings: no corresponding source columns exist, so those optional pointers stay unmapped instead of being guessed.
